exposure: reason for surgery (tubal ligation, hysterectomy, oophorectomy, ectopic pregnancy)
outcome: histological findings of fallopian tubes (normal appearance, chronic nonspecific salpingitis, tubal ectopic pregnancy, tubal gestation without features of salpingitis, paratubal cysts)
cohort: Women who underwent salpingectomy or tubal ligation at a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India, between May 2018 and April 2019.
finding: The majority of fallopian tubes (approximately 70%) had a normal appearance on histopathology, while chronic non-specific salpingitis was the most common pathological lesion found (9.8%) among the remaining cases.
